newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - Corporate Earnings.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS - Corporate Earnings.

text.p: The following companies reported corporate earnings on Wednesday:
* DuPont Co reported third quarter earnings of $1.60 per share after an $0.08 charge versus $1.38 a year ago. The First Call consensus estimate was $1.58. Shares fell 1/2 to 96-3/4.
* AlliedSignal Inc reported third quarter earnings of $0.90 per share, in line with the First Call estimate, versus $0.77 a year ago. Shares fell 1/8 to 64-5/8.

* Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc reported third quarter earnings of $0.72 per share versus pro forma earnings of $0.61 per share last year. Product recalls reduced current third quarter income by $0.17 per share. The First Call mean estimate was $0.80 per share. Shares fell 5/8 to 72-3/8.
* Marsh & McLennan Cos Inc reported third quarter income of $1.43 per share versus $1.26 last year. First Call's mean estimate was $1.39 per share. Shares rose 3/4 to 101-1/4.
* Dean Witter Discover & Co reported third quarter earnings of $1.41 per diluted share versus $1.23 a year ago. First Call mean estimate was $1.36. Shares rose one to 59-5/8.
* Sunbeam Corp reported a third quarter loss of $0.22 per share versus a profit of $0.11 last year. Shares fell 1/4 to 24-1/2.
* AirTouch Communications Inc reported third quarter earnings of $0.10 per share versus $0.09 a year ago. Shares rose 1/4 to 25-3/4.

* SCI Systems Inc reported first quarter earnings of $0.83 per primary share versus $0.51 a year ago. Earnings per diluted share were $0.75 versus $0.51. First Call mean estimate was $0.67. Shares rose 2-5/8 to 57-3/8.
